name: software-team
description: Baigong Software Team: five-seat SOP-driven software delivery — six-node flow with ledger-as-truth state machine, lease-gated writes, dual-seat independent review, built-in advisor-meeting and deep-research skills, four-stage deploy chain.

displayDescription.en: Auditable five-seat software delivery team: a Project Lead orchestrates Product, Architect Engineer, Development Engineer and QA Auditor. Work starts from requirements and acceptance criteria and runs the six-node flow (requirement, design, ticket breakdown, execution, release, grayscale) serially. Ledger as single source of truth, lease-gated writes and mechanical gates; Product and QA seats review every output independently — the producer never self-verdicts, the human keeps final call. Built-in advisor-meeting facilitation and evidence-based deep research; releases go through the four-stage gate chain: assemble, preview, human verification, deploy.
displayDescription.zh: 五席协作的可审计软件交付专家团：项目负责人统筹产品、架构、工程、质量审计四席，从需求与验收标准出发，沿六节点流程（需求→设计→拆票→执行→发布→灰度）串行推进；账本为唯一真相、租约写侧校验与机械门禁执法；产品席＋QA席对产出做独立复审（生成方不自判，人类保留终裁）；内置外部顾问讨论会主持与证据型深度调研能力，上线走『装配→预览→人工验证→部署』四段闸口链。

quickPrompts.en: I have a development requirement — run the standard flow: PRD, system design, ticket breakdown, serial execution, independent acceptance, with verdict evidence at every step.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个开发需求，请按标准流程走一遍：出 PRD、出设计、拆票、串行执行、独立验收，每步留判定证据。

quickPrompts.en: Independently review this design or delivery against a three-state coverage matrix item by item, list the must-fill gaps — the producer never self-verdicts, and the final call stays with me.
quickPrompts.zh: 这份设计／交付请做独立复审：按三态覆盖矩阵逐项给结论，列出必补项——生成方不自判，终裁归我。

quickPrompts.en: Host an external advisor meeting: prepare the topic pack, run multiple rounds of written exchange, and converge into a resolution document.
quickPrompts.zh: 组织一场外部顾问讨论会：帮我编制议题包，多轮书面交流后收敛出决议件。

quickPrompts.en: Research this tech choice, competitor or market: multi-source with citations and falsifiable conditions — lock the question before acting.
quickPrompts.zh: 调研这个技术选型／竞品／市场：要多源带引用、给出可推翻条件，先锁问题再动手。

quickPrompts.en: When changes to this team's own package or system go live: take the four-stage chain — assemble first, mount a preview card, and after my manual verification approve the formal deploy.
quickPrompts.zh: 本专家团自身的包／系统改动要上线时：按四段链上到预览——先装配、挂预览卡，我人工验证通过后再批准正式部署。

quickPrompts.en: Make one interface-preserving lightweight change to this existing project via a maintenance ticket: requirements, design and ticket breakdown merge into a light sign-off, while acceptance, release and grayscale stay intact — reconcile the change list item by item.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这个已有项目做一处不改接口的轻量变更，走维护票：需求／设计／拆票合轻签，验收、发布、灰度不减免，改动清单逐项对账。
